analogy.rationale: Hydantoin antiepileptics block voltage-gated sodium channels (SCN1A-11A), so the closest transcriptional analog is another sodium channel blocker; local anesthetics also target sodium channels, while calcium channel blockers and antiarrhythmics share ion-channel/electrical activity but different channels. These cells are non-neuronal and express low levels of neuronal sodium channels, so the response should be weak.
